Title: Shadow Data Ownership & Sync Overwrite Protection
Acceptance_Criteria: 1. origin_type added to shadow tables ('REPLICA', 'LOCAL'). 2. trigger_sync() uses INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE skipping origin_type='LOCAL'. 3. Incoming utdno collision aborts sync and logs warning.
Risks_and_Mitigations: Risk: Broken sync script or unhandled null columns. Mitigation: Preflight column validation; unit test sync pull with mocked local rows.
Testing_Requirements: Run trigger_sync() against test DB with mock local rows; assert zero local rows overwritten.

Title: FAAS Lifecycle State Machine & Approval Gates
Acceptance_Criteria: 1. create_faas supports state ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'CURRENT'). 2. POST /etracs/faas/{id}/submit transitions DRAFT->SUBMITTED. 3. POST /etracs/faas/{id}/approve sets state='CURRENT', dtapproved=NOW(), approved_by=UID, and cancels predecessor.
Risks_and_Mitigations: Risk: Premature issuance of draft declarations. Mitigation: Restrict search/print endpoints to filter state='CURRENT' for non-admin viewers.
Testing_Requirements: Test DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> CURRENT progression with role permissions.

Title: Relational Predecessor Persistence & Snapshots
Acceptance_Criteria: 1. create_faas/update_faas inserts into wp_assessor_faas_previous. 2. Supports Case 1 (resolving), Case 2 (NULL ID recorded), Case 3 (unresolved ID). 3. Locked snapshot fields populated. 4. Multiple predecessors (N:1) supported.
Risks_and_Mitigations: Risk: Foreign key violations if prevfaasid does not exist. Mitigation: Keep prevfaasid nullable; preserve legacy string in separate column if needed.
Testing_Requirements: Create consolidation FAAS with 2 predecessors; assert 2 rows in wp_assessor_faas_previous.

Title: Assessment Breakdown Scheduling & Auto-Totals
Acceptance_Criteria: 1. create_faas/update_faas accepts assessments array and inserts into wp_assessor_rpu_assessment. 2. total_market_value and total_assessed_value on wp_assessor_rpu are calculated deterministically.
Risks_and_Mitigations: Risk: Historical rounding differences in manual totals. Mitigation: Validate MV * AL% = AV within 0.05 tolerance or allow override with flag.
Testing_Requirements: Save property with Residential + Commercial lines; assert rpu totals match sum of assessment lines.

Title: RealProperty Parcel Reuse & Lineage Continuity
Acceptance_Criteria: 1. create_faas accepts existing realpropertyid. 2. Multiple RPUs attach to same parcel geometry without duplicate rows. 3. rpumaster pointers updated on approval.
Risks_and_Mitigations: Risk: Orphaning RPU if invalid realpropertyid passed. Mitigation: Verify realpropertyid exists before assignment; fallback to new parcel creation.
Testing_Requirements: Create building declaration referencing existing land realpropertyid; assert shared parcel ID.

Title: Structured Cancellation & Successor Linkage
Acceptance_Criteria: 1. cancel_faas requires cancelreason and cancelledbytdnos. 2. Sets canceldate, cancelledtimestamp. 3. Multi-predecessor cancellation supported.
Risks_and_Mitigations: Risk: Cancelling wrong record on partial TD match. Mitigation: Exact objid/tdno match required; confirmation modal in UI.
Testing_Requirements: Cancel declaration; verify cancelreason, date, and successor TD are recorded.

Title: Auditing, History Diffing & Change Logs
Acceptance_Criteria: 1. Every shadow FAAS mutation (create, update, submit, approve, cancel) logs to wp_assessor_audit_trail. 2. Captures old/new JSON diff.
Risks_and_Mitigations: Risk: Bloating audit trail with large BLOB data. Mitigation: Filter out heavy base64/image fields from diffs.
Testing_Requirements: Perform update on FAAS; assert audit trail record created with user ID and timestamp.

Title: ETRACS Frontend Workspace & Form Integration
Acceptance_Criteria: 1. EtracsPropertyTable displays status chips and origin badges ('REPLICA' vs 'LOCAL'). 2. Form modal includes assessment grid and multi-predecessors. 3. Cancel modal captures successor TD.
Risks_and_Mitigations: Risk: UI clutter or broken responsive layout. Mitigation: Modular tabbed interface conforming to existing 720p/1080p standards.
Testing_Requirements: End-to-end browser verification of declaration authoring, preview, and printing.

Title: Rollout, Migration Safety & Failure Injection Testing
Acceptance_Criteria: 1. Automated test suite verifying sync immunity, collision abort, and replica read-only guards. 2. Native table isolation assertion (COUNT=12,256).
Risks_and_Mitigations: Risk: Undetected regressions in native tables. Mitigation: Strict automated verification asserts 0 native modifications.
Testing_Requirements: Execute full test suite; assert 100% pass across all safety assertions.
